harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc and a systemd service inventory-worker on node1 running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker under that account. Verified the service is enabled/active and the process runs as inventorysvc. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reflects the new boot, and verified inventory-worker auto-started, is active/enabled, and its process runs as inventorysvc post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (AlmaLinux 9.6), confirmed root access and located /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Wrote systemd unit /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service running as inventorysvc/inventorysvc with ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, Restart=on-failure, NoNewPrivileges=yes
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now inventory-worker; verified active/running, process owned by inventorysvc
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime -s on node1
Issued systemctl reboot in background so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again; confirmed changed boot_id and new uptime -s timestamp
Verified inventory-worker service auto-started post-reboot, is active/enabled, and process runs as inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker running as managed service inventory-worker under inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: inventorysvc system user created; inventory-worker.service enabled and active, main process (pid 1610) and child owned by inventorysvc
Captured boot_id d6298ced-a924-4ce7-bbed-0fb8179eda8e and uptime -s 08:03:27, with service active/enabled prior to reboot
systemctl reboot issued in background; exec returned pid immediately (reboot issued pid=1667)

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node briefly unreachable (connection reset), then boot_id changed to ccf55dbd-f5d6-4a6a-9bc7-dc4c4c9ab1d5 with fresh uptime -s 08:04:09, proving an actual reboot occurred
After reboot, inventory-worker is active/enabled again with a new main PID (732), process confirmed running as inventorysvc
